entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: The lion-headed young god of the breaking dawn on Amonkhet, a champion of the peasantry born after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: Amonkhet god whom Ketramose considers his mother.

entities.name: Sab-Sunen
entities.description: A god whose arrival preceded Ketramose's birth.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: Confronts Munhatep at Temmet's tomb and prays to Ketramose.

entities.name: Munhatep
entities.description: Contests claim to Temmet's body and is tossed aside by Ketramose.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: Former vizier of Oketra, revived by Ketramose.

entities.name: Niharet
entities.description: Holds a khopesh to Basri's throat.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker stranded at an oasis who meets Ketramose.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed most of Amonkhet's gods.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: Amonkhet god thought to be the only one surviving Bolas.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Chandra describes this plane to Ketramose.

entities.name: Luxa
entities.description: River at whose banks Ketramose was born.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: A race event during whose lead-up Ketramose intervenes.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion after which Ketramose was born.

events.summary: Ketramose is born from the reeds on the banks of the restored Luxa after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: he rose from the sparkling water after the end of the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Answering Basri's prayers, Ketramose tears off the tomb roof, tosses Munhatep aside and revives Temmet.
events.quote: The god revived Temmet, declaring that he would serve Ketramose as he had Oketra.

events.summary: Ketramose appears to Chandra at an oasis, explains that the gods endure while life does, and shows her the way back.

relations.quote: He considers Oketra to be his mother.
